node.statement: For the arbitrary data of node 1 under 0 <= eta <= rho_2, insert successively Phi_n(tilde-Delta_n X tilde-Delta_n Y) and tilde-Delta_n(XY), apply the three preceding comparison bounds and the triangle inequality, and use C_theta >= 0, C_Delta-prime=C_T+4*C_theta, and C_2=C_Delta-prime+4*C_Delta. This yields ||Phi_n(Delta_n X Delta_n Y)-Delta_n(XY)|| <= [3*C_Delta+C_T+2*C_theta+C_Delta]*eta*||X||*||Y|| <= C_2*eta*||X||*||Y||.
